events.subject: China copper social inventory
events.fact: Mainstream-region copper inventory fell 19,700 mt WoW to 114,200 mt while end-user purchasing remained insufficient.
events.effect_basis: Lower visible inventory is supportive, but contemporaneous weak end-user purchasing offsets a clean directional inference.

events.subject: US copper tariff-driven trade flow
events.fact: Expected US refined-copper tariffs pulled metal toward the US, increasing COMEX stocks while reducing availability elsewhere.
events.effect_basis: Tightening outside the US is supportive to LME-linked pricing while accumulated US inventory is an offsetting regional supply signal.

events.subject: LME copper availability squeeze
events.fact: Available LME copper inventory was constrained and backwardation became extreme as physical deliveries responded to tightness.
events.effect_basis: Verified shortage of immediately available exchange metal and extreme backwardation are direct tightness signals, independent of the subsequent replay outcome.

policy: No event is Market Brain input until timestamp precision and source provenance satisfy the causal admission gate.
